def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    rs=[r for r in range(h) if any(v in (7,8) for v in grid[r])]
    cs=[c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] in (7,8) for r in range(h))]
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(rs)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(cs)-1):
            corners=[grid[rs[i]][cs[j]],grid[rs[i]][cs[j+1]],grid[rs[i+1]][cs[j]],grid[rs[i+1]][cs[j+1]]]
            bg=grid[rs[i]+1][cs[j]+1]
            row.append(corners[0] if corners[0] in (7,8) and all(x==corners[0] for x in corners) else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
